content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Guides gumroad

When comparing options for selling digital products, it's essential to understand what each platform offers. Gumroad, for instance, provides an easy-to-use interface for creators to sell their products, but it relies on Stripe for payment processing, which is not available in many countries. On the other hand, sovereign commerce infrastructure, such as the Edge Commerce Stack, offers a comprehensive solution that includes hosting, backend logic, order storage, and payment processing, all without relying on restricted platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Gumroad and PayPal have restrictions in place that prevent creators from certain countries from using their services. A PayPal account suspension can even hold funds for up to 180 days with no appeal, leaving creators without access to their earnings. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to work around these restrictions, providing creators with a reliable way to sell their products and receive payments, regardless of their location.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment processing, speed and fees are crucial factors to consider. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, such as the Edge Commerce Stack, uses NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, which offers a 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements. This means that creators can receive payments quickly and without incurring high fees, unlike traditional payment processors that can charge up to 5% per transaction.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure offers a 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements for payment processing.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the significant advantages of sovereign commerce infrastructure is that it allows creators to own their store and data, without relying on third-party platforms. With the Edge Commerce Stack, creators can automate their store's backend logic, order storage, and payment processing, ensuring a seamless and efficient delivery process. This level of control and automation is not possible with traditional platforms like Gumroad or PayPal.
